tools.name: get_restaurants
tools.title: Get Restaurants
tools.description: Fetches Muju Cafe and all local partner restaurants available for order placement.

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.title: Get Restaurant Menu
tools.description: Retrieves active food, momos, beverages, and pricing catalog for a specific restaurant. Note that items may include 'addonGroups' representing customization choices (e.g. fillings, options) that must or can be selected, each with potential price offsets that should be confirmed with the customer.

restaurantId.description: Restaurant ID, e.g. 'muju' or a partner ID

tools.name: submit_mcp_order
tools.title: Submit MCP Order
tools.description: Submits a new pickup order draft to Muju or partner restaurants. Immediately sends a 6-digit verification code (OTP) to the customer's email. Returns orderNumber and pending_verification status. The customer must provide the 6-digit OTP code, which must be submitted via verify_mcp_order to finalize the order and push it to the kitchen. Note: Delivery orders are currently not supported via MCP APIs; only pickup orders are accepted.

restaurantId.description: Leave empty or use 'muju' for Muju Cafe

name.description: Name of the menu item (e.g. 'Milk Tea', 'Mango Milk Tea', 'Chilli Momo', 'Chicken Chilli Momo')

quantity.description: Quantity of this item (must be positive integer, min 1)

selectedChoices.description: Optional list of customer-selected choices or add-ons for this menu item

groupTitle.description: The customization group title (e.g. 'Filling' or 'Flavor'). Optional.

name.description: The name of the chosen option (e.g. 'Mango', 'Chicken', 'Classic')

pickupTime.description: Specific target pickup time (e.g., '5:30 PM'). Required for all MCP pickup orders.

orderType.description: Order type: only 'pickup' is currently supported for MCP APIs

customerEmail.description: Customer email address, required for receipts and sending the 6-digit verification OTP

phoneNumber.description: Customer phone number with country code (e.g. +1 315-555-0199 for US/Canada or +[country code] for international), required for SMS confirmation

specialNote.description: Optional dietary requests or special kitchen instructions

paymentPreference.description: Payment method. MUST use 'online' for partner restaurants. Muju Cafe supports both 'online' and 'in_store'.

tools.name: verify_mcp_order
tools.title: Verify MCP Order
tools.description: Verifies the customer's identity by submitting the 6-digit OTP code sent to their email. Finalizes the order, pushes it to the kitchen, and returns the unguessable orderSecretToken needed to track order status.

otp.description: The 6-digit verification code sent to the customer's email

tools.name: verify_order
tools.title: Verify Order
tools.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code sent to customer email to finalize and commit the order to the kitchen.

otp.description: The 6-digit verification code sent to the customer's email

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Get Order Status
tools.description: Checks status of an order (payment status, kitchen status, delivery tracking). Requires the unguessable orderSecretToken generated when the order was submitted.

orderSecretToken.description: The secret security token returned when the order was created (e.g. sec_8f9a2b...)
